verdict.rationale: Notion is a SaaS workspace, so headless/CI automation means scripted API access, and the docs cover that well. The REST API can read, create and update nearly everything. Static internal-connection tokens and personal access tokens are explicitly positioned for scripts, CLI workflows and custom automations. Webhooks, Agent session APIs and a published OpenAPI spec support unattended, event-driven pipelines. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or an official CLI/CI action, documented rate limits for unattended runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
